mechanism: Every E record is K(n; a): a buffer (01)^n, then walls (single extra 0s) with gaps a_j. One cycle is a sequence of rightward passes and leftward sweeps. On reaching a wall with gap g after it: phase A shifts the wall right one pair (next phase A if g odd, else F); F opens it in place (D if g odd, else C); C opens it one pair further left (C if g odd, else D); D shifts it right and turns. The sweep closes open walls and bounces at the first shifted wall, which returns to its old place and acts as 'A at that wall'. The map reads gaps only through their parity (plus a zero test), so it is a parity automaton on the wall word: a uniform binary-counter hierarchy with two walls per level, wall 2m moving (2^m-1)/2^(2m-1) times per cycle. The irregular settled values are frozen offsets the dynamics never reads. Carry stage: the cycle map is a binary recursion Run(w,A) = Run(w+1,.)^2, Run(w,F) = one C/D chain; the A-tree is complete and Leaf_w^2 = Leaf_{w+1} up to a temporary shift, so every cycle is ONE chain, started at wall 2p+2 with level p = t1(k xor c) (c = 4672 start A, 4673 start E). Chain-law stage: the chain length of a level-q cycle is a selector-masked ruler, l = t1(((k^c)>>(2q+1)) ^ m_q[s]), s = bits q+1..2q of k^c, with 2^q irregular masks per level; but there is no steady state: from k = 650,686 D (and once F) meet double walls, walls merge, the right end is reached in phase D, and the region past wall ~17 becomes irregular, rewriting the masks of levels >= 5.
closed_gaps: Right-end routine ruled: it is local after all, 4 zero-run rules ZA/ZF/ZC/ZD (cut at the first leftward E move), plus R12 (F at a double wall), R13 (A at a double wall), F1, C1; 22 fixed rules + 6 sweep forms validated 8,400/8,400 twice (seeds 20261011 and 7), exact tape/state/head/steps (scripts/check_rules2.py)
